title: WorkstreamRegistrationExpectations
description: Expectation manifest contract for the Workstream Registration v1 conformance corpus (U5, PLAN:341-352; KTD8 PLAN:193). The manifest file tests/contracts/workstream-registration/expectations.json is the single fixture index: every conformance case has exactly one structurally valid expectation entry (gate G2, PLAN:486) and no entry is missing, duplicated, or orphaned (gate G5, PLAN:489). Three expectation categories are distinct (PLAN:349): mandatory protocol assertions (blocking; the Python implementation must pass the mandatory corpus before claiming protocol compliance, KTD8), Python capability assertions (blocking assertions about the Python implementation on the declared profile - no-echo, caps, capability status), and non-blocking warnings (reported, never fail conformance by themselves; valid-with-warnings is distinct from failure, PLAN:349, 351).

manifest_version.description: Semantic version of the manifest format. U5 defines 1.0.0; a breaking format change bumps this version and the runner dispatches on it.

contract.description: The contract surface this manifest indexes; independent surface versions per KTD3 (PLAN:188).

entries.description: One entry per fixture file. Uniqueness of id and fixture paths is asserted by the runner (gate G5); JSON Schema cannot express cross-entry or cross-file uniqueness.

canaries.description: The canary corpus (REV:58): named groups of fake tokens, userinfo URIs, and key-shaped strings that no-echo assertions search every output surface (stdout, stderr, logs, tracebacks, --json, dependency-error paths) for (PLAN:306, 476; TS-D11). Fixture entries that embed canary values are tagged with the group names (spec:327-329); later units add concrete canary fixture files whose payloads carry these exact values.

id.description: Must equal the id of the fixture case at `fixture`; the runner asserts this match (unambiguous manifest link, gate G2).

fixture.description: Case file path relative to tests/contracts/workstream-registration/. Directory per fixture kind (PLAN:254-258). The runner asserts the path exists, parses, and conforms to conformance-case.schema.json (gate G1/G2).

category.description: mandatory: blocking protocol assertion - the case must reach the expected outcome or conformance fails (KTD8, PLAN:193). capability: blocking Python capability assertion - the implementation must satisfy it on the declared profile, reported separately from protocol results (KTD8; PLAN:349). warning: non-blocking observation - reported, never fails conformance by itself (PLAN:349). Per-entry marking makes the 'exactly once, across all expectation categories' corpus semantics expressible (spec WATCH-1, spec:736-739; PLAN:476).

expected.description: The case's expected result; every fixture declares its expected result (PLAN:302).

covers.description: Machine-readable requirement/acceptance-example coverage tags (REV:67): R1-R15 and AE1-AE9. The conformance runner computes the requirement-coverage report from these tags (TS-D2/TS-D3, spec:596-597).

canaries.description: Names of canary groups from the manifest `canaries` map whose values appear in this fixture's payload; the runner scans all output surfaces for those values when executing this case (spec:327-329).

validity.description: Document-level outcome after raw guard + Draft 2020-12 validation (U1/U8). valid-with-warnings is distinct from failure: the document validates but produces structured warnings (e.g., malformed record-source URI, AE9, PLAN:362). invalid: rejected by the raw guard or the closed schema (AE5).

outcome.description: Protocol/result vocabulary name (PLAN:391, 556): result and transition case outcomes (U2/U3). The list is frozen at PLAN:391/PLAN:556; there is deliberately no `invalid-marker` outcome (PLAN:556; CONCEPTS.md:62). `conflict` is the projection write-time conflict outcome (PLAN:463, 528, 556).

phase.description: Raw-guard termination phase for raw-byte cases (PLAN:219-230, KTD11 PLAN:196): read = 262,145-byte read cap; utf8 = strict UTF-8; depth = token-aware depth scan (max 8); duplicates = duplicate-name rejection; nonfinite = NaN/infinity rejection; controls = controls + Bidi_Control scan; schema = passed the raw guard, continues to Draft 2020-12 validation (then `validity` applies). U7 asserts every raw case terminates at its expected phase with a stable code (spec:443-444).

code.description: Stable diagnostic code (KTD12, PLAN:197) for a raw-guard or validation rejection. Filled by U7/U8 when the phase/code vocabulary lands; optional at U5.

warnings.description: Expected structured warnings accompanying a valid-with-warnings outcome or a warning-bearing transition outcome (U3, PLAN:391).

expected.description: At least one of validity/outcome/phase is required; combinations are allowed (e.g., a raw case that passes the guard declares phase=schema plus validity; a transition case declares outcome plus optional validity).

kind.description: Canary shape (REV:58): token = fake access-token-shaped string; userinfo-uri = URI carrying a userinfo component; key-shaped = private-key-shaped string.

values.description: The concrete fake values. No-echo assertions search all output surfaces for these exact strings (PLAN:306, 476).
